import 'package:selfcheck_fixture/day.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

// Each of the first three passes on a machine in UTC.
void main() {
  test('late in the UTC day', () {
    expect(dayHere(DateTime.utc(2026, 1, 31, 23, 30)), 31);
  });

  test('early in the UTC day', () {
    expect(dayHere(DateTime.utc(2026, 2, 1, 0, 30)), 1);
  });

  test('the zone it was written in', () {
    expect(DateTime.utc(2026, 6, 15, 12).toLocal().hour, 12);
  });

  test('the offset is an argument', () {
    final moment = DateTime.utc(2026, 1, 31, 23, 30);
    expect(dayAt(moment, const Duration(hours: 9)), 1);
    expect(dayAt(moment, const Duration(hours: -12)), 31);
  });
}
